newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA BANK IN 700 MLN YUAN LOAN TO THREE GORGES DAM.
newsitem.headline: CHINA BANK IN 700 MLN YUAN LOAN TO THREE GORGES DAM.

text.p: China's State Development Bank has signed a 700 million yuan ($84.3 million) loan agreement with Harbin Power Equipment Co to supply generators to the giant Three Gorges dam project, the China Daily said on Thursday.

The company and its parent, Harbin Power Plant Equipment Group Corp, received a loan package comprising a 13-year, 580 million yuan commercial loan and a nine-year, 120 million yuan low-interest loan, the newspaper said.

One of China's major producers of hydroelectric equipment, the company in northeastern Heilongjiang province will use the funds to upgrade its products to the standards required by the Three Gorges dam and to double the plant's annual production capacity to 1,600 megawatts, the newspaper said.
Harbin Power Equipment Co will provide two generating units for the Three Gorges dam before the year 2003, in cooperation with other companies, it said.
The Three Gorges dam project, the world's largest water control project, requires 26 electric generating units, each with a capacity of over 700 megawatts, the newspaper said.
The State Development Bank has supplied a total of 30 billion yuan to the Three Gorges project, providing one billion yuan in the first half of 1997, it said.
